author_role: Astra controller: physics, contract and acceptance

central_handoff.HEAD: 0f9d9df825be1dac9ca9bdf73cdc2e8908bcba17
central_handoff.open_binding: Named REI state and excited-atom reservoir owner, native/detached radiative owner and source/domain/clock binding must be accepted by REI owner.

question: Export conservative instantaneous bound-bound H I level, thermal, excited-atom and radiative source columns from immutable saved PHYS83 rates without recalculating rates or trajectories.

source.rates: only 66 exact stored float64 temperatures and both upper levels; reject absent T, interpolation and extrapolation
source.electron_distribution: Maxwellian, heavy stationary target, unpolarized LS source-native finite CCC operator
source.Nthermal: positive finite supplied ideal-gas particle density >= n1s+n2s+n2p+ne and <=1e20; spectator particles allowed
source.high_density: formal finite-star diagnostics only; no physical high-density completeness

equations.particle_sources: sum level sources=0, electron=0, thermal particle=0, nuclei=0, charge=0
equations.temperature_source: 2*Qthermal/(3*kB*Nthermal); instantaneous ideal common-T bath source only, no integration
equations.spectral_contract: 2gamma event energy is Delta shared by two photons. No monochromatic Delta/2 or spectrum is supplied.

ownership.immediate_escape: Qescaped=Qemitted,Qradiation_injected=0; matches parent's optically thin cell boundary
ownership.emissivity_handoff: Qradiation_injected=Qemitted,Qescaped=0; source-only export, transport and residence are unimplemented
ownership.diagnostic_not_additional_energy: Qemitted is diagnostic; add only the selected radiation column to conservation
forbidden: chemical binding silently absorbing excitation energy
dynamic spectrum or coupled trajectory admission

implementation.language: Python standard library; binary64 source arithmetic, math.fsum for signed sums
implementation.input_guard: validate all four pinned parent files before use; 132 unique rows=66 paired T; finite positive rates; refuse booleans, NaN/Inf/negative/overflow and positive-event underflow; reject unsupported owner and missing exact T
implementation.numerics: no clipping, rescaling or enforced-zero residual. Return actual signed energy and nucleus residuals and gross normalization; reject nonfinite outputs.
implementation.output: versioned JSON records with parent/adapter identity, exact stored T label, supplied state/owner/route, seven event intensities, level derivatives, electron/thermal-particle sources, six energy columns, photon counts, signed temperature source and actual residuals
implementation.persistent_application: create-only output with COMPLETE and result hash; identity includes source, contract, code, fixtures and dependency pins. Resume must check identity and every result byte before skip; never overwrite a failed or mismatched completion.
implementation.temperature_arithmetic: Qthermal==0 -> Tdot=0, otherwise (2/(3*kB))*(Qthermal/Nthermal); refuse nonfinite or positive-magnitude underflow output
implementation.positive_product_arithmetic: Largest-first binary64 products within bounded density/rate domain, reject a positive true product rounding to zero; zero factor returns exact zero. No rate interpolation.

application.label: new bounded algebraic source application from reused rates and explicitly constructed local states; not observed trajectories
application.maximum_new_runs_scope: one real16row source application; interface verification, mocked callback controls and byte-verified completed resume are counted separately; no callback on actual completed resume

acceptance.reference: independent exact-rational event incidence and energy arithmetic from literal CSV decimal values, not production helper calls
acceptance.zero_fixtures: exact zero where all corresponding event intensities vanish
controls: distinguish emitted diagnostic from one owned radiation destination
2gamma energy not doubled but photon count doubled
ground cooling with zero instantaneous emission
pure radiative decay with zero thermal source
acceptance.independent_review: fresh Astra reads actual diff and raw outcomes before admission/publication

normalizations.G_event: sum of seven nonnegative event intensities
normalizations.zero_gross: corresponding actual and reference outputs must be exactly zero

resources_and_budget.policy: unknown is not zero; retain parent campaign and failure receipts; no new heavy launch
resources_and_budget.incremental_scope: bounded standard-library algebra, targeted new-interface verification and one16row application

new_attempt_caps.scope: per authorized child process; limits do not reset inherited monetary budget or erase previous failed attempts

publication.mode: additive Draft, expected-SHA compare-and-swap, no merge
publication.central_DAG: additive WU return overlay; original central files unchanged

preimplementation_review.F1: Named error denominators and exact zero conventions; six energy columns frozen
preimplementation_review.F2: Per-attempt CPU/wall caps; verification mocks separate from one application
preimplementation_review.F3: Corrected Korean nonnegativity wording and stable temperature division; no physics change
